title: First timer, looking for the best direction to go with this
author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/i0fd6kuj14vh1.png?width=1133&format=png&auto=webp&s=eddf3761454b4481fc32dcdb83314f8f8c646b0a

As you can see this is literally just straight out of the box in terms of UI, layout and all that. I ran out of free credits on lovable and I was going to get a subscription but then I thought of you guys and wanted to see what reccomendations you guys have. It's 100 credits a month for $25 and I was just thinking those credits will probably get used within an hour, so I'd love to know what you guys think the best option is in terms of cost/credits?

  
The basic game idea I have here is pretty basic, but I'd like to expand it to a hybrid tabletop/card battle game. I'm not really interested in super flashy visuals, I'm just on the poverty line and really want to know where I can get the most bang for my buck. Would LOVE if there are any 100% free options, but I'm willing to get a subscription as long as it's $50 or under, I can't justify spending more than that. If you're curious about the game, I'll leave a link in the comments

comments.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
comments.body:
[https://field-nine.lovable.app](https://field-nine.lovable.app)

This is where it's at after I ran out of credits lmao. I wanted to have the ability to delete cards from your deck, a basic shop and some kind of currency system

comments.author: space-bee-1
comments.body: If you’re ready to spend $50/month , I would try the plus plan of ChatGPT. ($20/month) I have used it and it’s been great, for something like this you would probably make good use out of it

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: Ok I'll check that out now. I just tried out Base44 and I'm not entirely sure if it's nailing the feel I want.,

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: Hey, I have the plus subscription and I plugged the same prompt but instead of actually making a game it made the cards. Do I need to do anything in particular to get it into game making mode?

replies.author: space-bee-1
replies.body: It looks like you have a semi functional base as it is, I would have Claude or codex inspect what you have and then add features incrementally from there rather than expecting it to make the full game in one go

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: I've actually been having a BLAST so far. I've been iterating and tweaking the UI to make it more stylised, and gradually feeding in more rewarding mechanics like different damage types/resistances, proper card style art, rarity etc. Is claude an extra cost or does that come with chatGPT?

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: Genuinely I had no idea just how fun vibe coding would be lmao. As someone who has zero knowledge about how to actually make a game this is a great way to test out ideas. I'm approaching it in aa way that I think makes sense too, working on the gameplay/mechanics first and foremost, and then the aesthetics just to sort of get "in the mood" and set the scene, then I want to work on the actual UI so it doesn't look so generic. Then i want to work on a storyline that would facilitate a campaign, and that process makes sense to me. Before I probably would have gone storyline first but that makes no sense for a game like this

comments.author: redcard420
comments.body: Get 100 month plan Claude- can run opus5.5 max basically 24/7!
